**Hub path:** `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go` (HTTP endpoint in `server/router/api/v1/sse_handler.go`, event builders in `server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go`)

Event types are `memo.created`, `memo.updated`, `memo.deleted`, `memo.comment.created`, `reaction.upserted`, `reaction.deleted` (lines 15–20). **Engine: CEL (Google's Common Expression Language, `github.com/google/cel-go`) — `internal/filter/` (`engine.go`, `parser.go`, `ir.go`, `render.go`, `schema.go`, `helpers.go`)**

- `authInterceptor` (`/bench/repo/web/src/connect.ts:156`) is installed on the shared Connect transport (line 188). On each request it resolves a token via `getRequestToken()` (line 124) and sets `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (line 97). It refreshes preemptively when the token is within `REQUEST_TOKEN_EXPIRY_BUFFER_MS` of expiry (line 140), and reactively on a `Code.Unauthenticated` response — retrying once with an `X-Retry` marker, then calling `redirectOnAuthFailure()` if the refresh fails (lines 163–177).

The refresh token itself is never read by JS — it rides along as a cookie because both transports use `fetchWithCredentials` (line 57). Access-token storage/expiry lives in `/bench/repo/web/src/auth-state.ts` (`getAccessToken`, `setAccessToken`, `isTokenExpired`, `clearAccessToken`).
